# Tests skipped by the Windows CI job, with the issue each one belongs to.
#
# A ledger, not a dustbin. Every line is a bug we found by running the
# suite on Windows for the first time (#143) and have written down rather
# than hidden; every line disappears when its issue closes. Skipping by
# NAME rather than by module or by test binary is deliberate — a broad
# `--skip arena` would swallow the next arena failure silently, which is
# exactly how these went unnoticed while we shipped Windows binaries.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.

# --- #145: two arena tests, 32 threads x 2 GiB of reservation -------------
# The disjoint-regions test holds 32 threads at a barrier, each reserving
# 2 GiB of address space, and asks Windows for 64 GiB. Threads that cannot
# reserve fall back to the system allocator — supported behaviour — and
# their null base reads as a shared region.
arena::tests::concurrent_threads_get_disjoint_regions_and_release_them
arena::tests::a_thread_that_found_the_registry_full_recovers_when_a_slot_frees

# --- #146: imported files report absolute paths ---------------------------
# One root cause, nineteen symptoms: the entry file relativises against the
# working directory and every file reached through the importer does not,
# so stack frames, warn events, quiet-deps provenance, dependency tracking
# and source maps all name `c:\users\runner~1\...\src\foo.scss` where dart
# names `src/foo.scss`.
callables_and_content_blocks_run_against_their_defining_file
dependency_provenance_survives_the_import_cache
error_in_a_content_block_points_at_the_include
error_inside_an_imported_mixin_renders_its_source
first_class_callables_are_traced_like_direct_ones
fs_importer_tracks_load_path_dependencies
import_deprecations_fire_when_a_file_is_parsed
imported_callable_output_maps_to_its_file_and_content_to_the_includers
imports_sharing_a_basename_are_distinct_sources
members_forwarded_through_an_import_keep_their_defining_file
misplaced_import_is_rejected_like_dart
quiet_deps_record_is_per_compilation_even_with_a_reused_importer
quiet_deps_record_is_reentrant_across_a_nested_compile
quiet_deps_record_is_scoped_even_when_the_compile_fails_early
quiet_deps_survives_a_compile_error_with_error_css
source_map_sources_name_imported_files_by_path
stack_frames_show_loaded_files_relative_to_the_working_directory
warn_event_path_is_the_resolved_file_path
warn_events_inside_callables_carry_the_defining_file
